request FactorioVersionsRequest.reason: Hosts send it while starting an instance, which a 2.0.3 controller rejects so the start fails.
request FactorioVersionsRequest.impact: The host stays connected and the instance goes back to stopped with the error shown, starting it works again once the controller is updated.

request LatestReleasesRequest.reason: Hosts send it while starting an instance that targets a release channel such as stable.
request LatestReleasesRequest.impact: Hosts send FactorioVersionsRequest first, so a 2.0.3 controller rejects the start before this is sent, starting it works again once the controller is updated.
